vision: To become a national and regional reference institution in research, policy, and financing of a fair and sustainable energy transition
mission: Integrating energy, economic, and financial research into public policy.
Providing financing solutions for transition projects and policies.
Strengthening institutional capacity and governance for energy transition.
Becoming a strategic partner for the government, state-owned enterprises, and international organizations.

expertise.title: Energy Economics and Finance
expertise.body: Economic and financial analysis of energy systems, investment feasibility, electricity pricing, and project evaluation.

expertise.title: Sustainable Finance and Green Investment
expertise.body: Mobilization of capital through ESG principles, green bonds, blended finance, and sustainable investment strategies.

expertise.title: Electricity Market Structure and Regulation
expertise.body: Design, restructuring, pricing mechanisms, and competition analysis for efficient and transparent power markets.

expertise.title: Risk Management and Energy Systems
expertise.body: Risk quantification, uncertainty modeling, and resilience frameworks for energy infrastructure and projects.

expertise.title: Energy Policy and Governance
expertise.body: Formulation, analysis, and evaluation of policies and regulations to guide energy transition and long-term planning.

expertise.title: Macroeconomics and Public Policy in Energy
expertise.body: Study of subsidies, tariffs, and fiscal instruments shaping energy access, affordability, and welfare

expertise.title: Renewable Energy Transition & Sustainability
expertise.body: Integration of solar, hydro, wind, hydrogen, and other renewable sources, including techno-economic and sustainability assessments.

expertise.title: Climate Change and Energy Resilience
expertise.body: Assessment of climate risks, adaptation strategies, and resilience planning for energy systems.

expertise.title: Carbon Pricing & Environmental Economics
expertise.body: Application of carbon markets, carbon taxes, and renewable energy certificates to accelerate decarbonization.

expertise.title: Technology and Innovation in Energy
expertise.body: Evaluation of disruptive technologies, digital solutions, and innovation ecosystems driving energy transition.

expertise.title: Electric Vehicles and Emerging Technologies
expertise.body: Analysis of EV adoption, charging networks, hydrogen mobility, and innovation pathways.

expertise.title: Energy Law and Regulation
expertise.body: Legal frameworks for energy markets, environmental compliance, and governance of energy resources.

expertise.title: Consumer Behaviour and Technology Adoption
expertise.body: Understanding behavioral, social, and cultural factors that influence acceptance of clean energy technologies.

expertise.title: Capacity Building and Knowledge Transfer
expertise.body: Design of training, education, and institutional strengthening programs to build expertise in energy economics and policy.
